Laurie's friend and Sheriff Brackett's daughter.

How Annie Brackett connects

  • Location: Haddonfield — Annie babysits in Haddonfield on Halloween night.
  • Character: Sheriff Leigh Brackett — Sheriff Brackett is Annie's father and Haddonfield's law.
